gaps.description: It is not specified how the system handles the selection of which unit is free and which is paid when multiple items or batches are added at different times or prices (e.g., if a customer adds an item at regular price, then adds another later, or if prices change).
gaps.suggested_question: When units of the same SKU have different prices (e.g. due to price updates or markdowns), how does the system determine which specific unit is designated as the free unit?

gaps.description: The requirements do not specify where in the UI/UX the 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' text must be displayed (e.g., next to the line item, in a summary banner, or on the receipt) or how free units are represented in the line item breakdown.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the exact UI placement and formatting requirements for displaying 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' on the cart and checkout screens?

gaps.description: The behavior when revalidating BOGO eligibility fails at checkout (e.g., product becomes out of stock, promotion expires, or SKU loses eligibility between cart and checkout) is missing, specifically regarding user notification and blocking order placement.
gaps.suggested_question: What specific error message or user feedback must be displayed, and should the checkout process be blocked, if BOGO eligibility validation fails during checkout before order placement?

gaps.description: It is not specified how precedence or conflict resolution is handled when multiple promotions exist and BOGO cannot be combined with another product-level promotion (REQ-012 / BR-004). Which promotion takes priority?
gaps.suggested_question: If a BOGO-eligible item is also eligible for another product-level promotion, how does the system decide which promotion takes precedence when they cannot be combined?

gaps.description: The exact user notification or messaging required when a promotion expires during checkout and the total is recalculated (REQ-013 / BR-005) is undefined.
gaps.suggested_question: What message or notification should be presented to the user if the BOGO promotion expires during checkout and the cart total is recalculated?

scenarios.title: Automatic BOGO Application for Two Units
scenarios.description: Verifies that the BOGO promotion is applied automatically without a coupon code when exactly two units of the same BOGO-eligible SKU are added to the cart.

scenarios.title: Correct Pricing for BOGO Eligible Pair
scenarios.description: Verifies that for every eligible pair, exactly one unit is charged at the regular selling price and the second unit is made free using the matching SKU.

scenarios.title: Promotion Text Display for BOGO Items
scenarios.description: Verifies that the text 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' is correctly displayed for any item receiving the offer.

scenarios.title: Removal of Free-Item Benefit on Quantity Reduction Below Minimum
scenarios.description: Verifies that reducing the eligible quantity below two immediately removes the free-item benefit.

scenarios.title: Scaling BOGO Free Units for Odd and Even Quantities
scenarios.description: Verifies that free unit scaling applies correctly, providing one free unit for three eligible units and two free units for four eligible units based on the floor formula.

scenarios.title: Exclusion of Non-BOGO Products
scenarios.description: Verifies that products not marked as BOGO eligible do not receive the BOGO promotion.

scenarios.title: Checkout Revalidation of BOGO Eligibility

scenarios.title: Restriction on Combining BOGO with Other Product-Level Promotions
scenarios.description: Verifies that BOGO cannot be combined with another product-level promotion on the same unit.

scenarios.title: Checkout Handling for Expired Promotion
scenarios.description: Verifies that if the promotion expires before order placement, checkout removes the BOGO benefit and recalculates the total.

test_cases.title: Verify automatic BOGO application with quantity 2 of same BOGO-eligible SKU and no coupon
test_cases.objective: Proves that adding exactly two units of the same BOGO-eligible SKU to the cart applies the BOGO promotion automatically without a coupon code.
preconditions: The user is logged into the shopping cart application.
A BOGO-eligible SKU is available in the catalog.

steps.action: Navigate to the product catalog and select a product with same BOGO-eligible SKU.
steps.expected: Product details page is displayed.

steps.action: Set the quantity to 2 and add the items to the cart without entering any coupon code.
steps.expected: Items are added to the cart.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and view the line items.
steps.expected: The cart displays the items with the BOGO promotion applied automatically.

test_cases.expected_result: The cart automatically applies the BOGO promotion for 2 units of the same BOGO-eligible SKU without requiring a coupon code, resulting in one free item.

test_cases.title: Verify free unit pricing and matching SKU assignment for eligible pair
test_cases.objective: Proves the intent of charging regular price for one unit and making the second unit free using the matching SKU for every eligible pair.
preconditions: The shopping cart contains an eligible pair of BOGO items.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and review the itemized price breakdown for the BOGO eligible pair.
steps.expected: The pricing details for the eligible pair are displayed.

test_cases.expected_result: Confirm with the product owner how the system handles the selection of which unit is free and which is paid when multiple items or batches are added at different times or prices.

test_cases.title: Verify promotion text display for items receiving the BOGO offer
test_cases.objective: Proves the intent of displaying 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' for any item receiving the offer.
preconditions: An item in the cart has successfully received the BOGO promotion.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and inspect the line item receiving the BOGO offer.
steps.expected: Line item details are displayed.

test_cases.expected_result: Confirm with the product owner where in the UI/UX the 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' text must be displayed (e.g., next to the line item, in a summary banner, or on the receipt) and how free units are represented.

test_cases.title: Verify immediate removal of free-item benefit when eligible quantity is reduced below two
test_cases.objective: Proves that reducing the eligible quantity below two immediately removes the free-item benefit.
preconditions: The cart contains 2 units of a BOGO-eligible SKU with the BOGO benefit active.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and update the quantity of the BOGO-eligible SKU from 2 to eligible_quantity (1).
steps.expected: Cart quantity updates to 1.

steps.action: Review the cart summary and line item details.
steps.expected: The free-item benefit is removed immediately and the total recalculates to the regular price for 1 unit.

test_cases.expected_result: Reducing the eligible quantity to 1 immediately removes the free-item benefit.

test_cases.title: Verify free unit scaling below boundary with eligible quantity 2
test_cases.objective: Proves free unit calculation for an eligible quantity just below the threshold of 3.
preconditions: The shopping cart is empty.

steps.action: Add eligible_quantity (2) units of a BOGO-eligible SKU to the cart.
steps.expected: 2 units are added to the cart.

steps.action: View the cart summary.
steps.expected: Exactly 1 free unit is applied based on floor(2 / 2).

test_cases.expected_result: For 2 eligible units, exactly 1 free unit is allocated.

test_cases.title: Verify exclusion of products not marked as BOGO eligible
test_cases.objective: Proves that products not marked as BOGO eligible do not receive the BOGO promotion.
preconditions: The shopping cart is empty.
A product exists in the catalog that is product_eligibility: not marked.

steps.action: Navigate to the product catalog and select a product that is not marked BOGO eligible.
steps.expected: Product details page is displayed.

steps.action: Add 2 units of the non-eligible product to the cart.
steps.expected: 2 units are added to the cart.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and review the promotion status.
steps.expected: No BOGO promotion is applied, and both units are charged at regular price.

test_cases.expected_result: Products not marked as BOGO eligible do not receive the BOGO promotion.

test_cases.title: Verify BOGO eligibility revalidation at checkout before order placement
test_cases.objective: Proves the intent of revalidating BOGO eligibility at checkout before order placement.
preconditions: The cart contains items with an applied BOGO promotion.
The user proceeds to the checkout stage before order placement.

steps.action: Navigate to the checkout screen.
steps.expected: Checkout screen is displayed.

test_cases.expected_result: Confirm with the product owner the behavior when revalidating BOGO eligibility fails at checkout (e.g., product becomes out of stock, promotion expires, or SKU loses eligibility between cart and checkout), specifically regarding user notification and blocking order placement.

test_cases.title: Verify restriction against combining different eligible SKUs into a BOGO pair
test_cases.objective: Proves that only identical SKUs can form a BOGO pair and different eligible SKUs cannot be combined.
preconditions: The shopping cart is empty.
Two different BOGO-eligible SKUs exist in the catalog.

steps.action: Add 1 unit of the first BOGO-eligible SKU to the cart.
steps.expected: 1 unit is added to the cart.

steps.action: Add 1 unit of a different BOGO-eligible SKU to the cart (sku_combination).
steps.expected: Second unit is added to the cart.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and check for BOGO promotion application.
steps.expected: No BOGO promotion is applied because the SKUs are different.

test_cases.expected_result: Different eligible SKUs cannot be combined to form a BOGO pair; only identical SKUs form a BOGO pair.

test_cases.title: Verify restriction on combining BOGO with another product-level promotion on the same unit
test_cases.objective: Proves that BOGO cannot be combined with another product-level promotion on the same unit.
preconditions: A BOGO-eligible SKU also has another product-level promotion applicable to it.

steps.action: Add 2 units of the SKU with both BOGO and another product_type promotion to the cart (unit_combination).
steps.expected: 2 units are added to the cart.

steps.action: Open the Cart screen and check the applied promotions.
steps.expected: The system prevents combining BOGO with the other product-level promotion on the same unit, applying only one or displaying an error/restriction.

test_cases.expected_result: BOGO cannot be combined with another product-level promotion on the same unit.

test_cases.title: Verify checkout handling when promotion expires before order placement
test_cases.objective: Proves the intent of removing the BOGO benefit and recalculating the total if the promotion expires before order placement.
preconditions: Items with an applied BOGO promotion are in the cart.
The promotion state is promotion_state: expired.

steps.action: Proceed to checkout with items where the promotion has expired.
steps.expected: Checkout process is initiated.

test_cases.expected_result: Confirm with the product owner the exact user notification or messaging required when a promotion expires during checkout and the total is recalculated.
